description: This file defines the ReviewReviewerRatingParamRule class, which extends an abstract validation rule and performs validation of reviewer ratings for performance review KPIs within the OrangeHRM system. It ensures ratings are within valid ranges and associated with correct KPIs, utilizing service traits for data access.

classes.name: ReviewReviewerRatingParamRule
classes.description: A validation rule class that checks the correctness of reviewer rating data related to KPIs in a performance review context.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the rule with a specific review ID.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the provided ratings array to ensure each entry has correct KPI IDs, rating values within allowed ranges, and are associated with the review.
